S7 Experiment Logger
func:
msg.s7 =
    msg.s7 || {};

msg.meta =
    msg.meta || {};

function csv(v) {

    if (
        v === undefined ||
        v === null
    ) {
        return "";
    }

    const s =
        String(v);

    if (
        s.includes(",") ||
        s.includes('"') ||
        s.includes("\n")
    ) {

        return (
            '"' +
            s.replace(
                /"/g,
                '""'
            ) +
            '"'
        );
    }

    return s;
}

const columns = [
    "timestamp",
    "run_id",
    "msgid",
    "decision_number",
    "replay_seq",
    "source_line",
    "source_epoch_ms",
    "raw_slots_bits",
    "load_phase",
    "load_phase_changed",
    "load_target_workers",
    "selected_site",
    "previous_site",
    "switch_occurred",
    "switch_reason",
    "edge_CPU_raw_percent",
    "edge_CPU_EWMA_percent",
    "edge_latency_EWMA_ms",
    "cloud_latency_EWMA_ms",
    "CPU_penalty_ms",
    "edge_cost_ms",
    "cloud_cost_ms",
    "edge_healthy_decision",
    "cloud_healthy_decision",
    "edge_healthy_final",
    "cloud_healthy_final",
    "dwell_count",
    "superiority_count",
    "primary_attempt_site",
    "primary_attempt_status",
    "primary_attempt_latency_ms",
    "primary_http_status",
    "fallback_used",
    "fallback_site",
    "fallback_status",
    "fallback_latency_ms",
    "final_success",
    "final_execution_site",
    "total_latency_ms",
    "service_inference_ms",
    "prediction",
    "confidence",
    "probabilities_json",
    "model_sha256"
];

const values = [
    new Date().toISOString(),

    msg.s7.run_id || "",

    msg._msgid || "",

    msg.s7.decision_number ?? "",

    msg.meta.replay_seq ?? "",

    msg.meta.source_line ?? "",

    msg.meta.source_epoch_ms ?? "",

    msg.meta.raw_slots_bits ?? "",

    msg.s7.load_phase || "",

    msg.s7.load_phase_changed
        ? 1
        : 0,

    msg.s7.load_target_workers ?? "",

    msg.s7.selected_site || "",

    msg.s7.previous_site || "",

    msg.s7.switch_occurred
        ? 1
        : 0,

    msg.s7.switch_reason || "",

    msg.s7.edge_CPU_raw_percent ?? "",

    msg.s7.edge_CPU_EWMA_percent ?? "",

    msg.s7.edge_latency_EWMA_ms ?? "",

    msg.s7.cloud_latency_EWMA_ms ?? "",

    msg.s7.CPU_penalty_ms ?? "",

    msg.s7.edge_cost_ms ?? "",

    msg.s7.cloud_cost_ms ?? "",

    msg.s7.edge_healthy_decision
        ? 1
        : 0,

    msg.s7.cloud_healthy_decision
        ? 1
        : 0,

    msg.s7.edge_healthy_final
        ? 1
        : 0,

    msg.s7.cloud_healthy_final
        ? 1
        : 0,

    msg.s7.dwell_count ?? "",

    msg.s7.superiority_count ?? "",

    msg.s7.primary_attempt_site || "",

    msg.s7.primary_attempt_status || "",

    msg.s7.primary_attempt_latency_ms ?? "",

    msg.s7.primary_http_status ?? "",

    msg.s7.fallback_used
        ? 1
        : 0,

    msg.s7.fallback_site || "",

    msg.s7.fallback_status || "",

    msg.s7.fallback_latency_ms ?? "",

    msg.s7.final_success
        ? 1
        : 0,

    msg.s7.final_execution_site || "",

    msg.s7.total_latency_ms ?? "",

    msg.s7.service_inference_ms ?? "",

    msg.s7.prediction || "",

    msg.s7.confidence ?? "",

    JSON.stringify(
        msg.s7.probabilities || {}
    ),

    msg.s7.model_sha256 || ""
];

let line =
    values.map(csv)
    .join(",") +
    "\n";

if (
    flow.get(
        "s7_logger_header_written"
    ) !== true
) {

    line =
        columns.join(",") +
        "\n" +
        line;

    flow.set(
        "s7_logger_header_written",
        true
    );
}

msg.payload = line;

return msg;
